ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 20-25% of the visible surface area, concentrated at the distal tips, while low-intensity black pixels occupy approximately 75-80% of the central and proximal surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are located at the far distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large, dense, irregularly shaped white patch extending from the far-left edge inward. The right lobe displays a smaller, fragmented white cluster at the far-right tip. The central region is a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a deep, V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits a high-frequency serration pattern with multiple peaks and valleys. Notable high-amplitude peaks are visible along the upper-left margin, while the upper-right margin contains a deep, distinct irregular valley (notch).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer edges of both lobes follow a convex curvature sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters are visible within the dark regions and along the margins of the distal white patches, particularly on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions are detectable on the ventral surface of the right lobe, breaking the uniform black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge shows significant acquired trauma in the form of deep, irregular indentations and jagged nicks, most notably a large notch on the upper margin of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary interface between the high-intensity white patches and the low-intensity black central region is highly interdigitated and non-linear, especially on the left lobe.
